subject.title: fix(text): strip MiniMax marker from channel replies

question: Must this external PR provide an observed after-fix official MiniMax delivery before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof gate based on the stream tests and existing screenshots?
rationale: The implementation and synthetic coverage are strong, but the current evidence does not exercise the exact official-provider runtime path whose event stream is being rewritten.

options.title: Require official-provider proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs from an after-fix `minimax` or `minimax-portal` turn before merge.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the focused tests and existing cross-provider evidence as sufficient despite the missing live official-provider result.

recommendation.title: Require official-provider proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs from an after-fix `minimax` or `minimax-portal` turn before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They established the provider-boundary requirement and already evaluated live official-versus-hosted MiniMax behavior in this PR.
